description: Integration test script: expediter + CRUD + queue senders

entries.question_pattern: What topic would you like me to research?
What topic would you like me to research and turn into a podcast?
Would you like to set a budget limit in dollars?
Any additional context about the audience?

entries._comment: The OPEN-ENDED DESCRIBE-IT ask (row 0c280989), keyed on the ask's own id rather than its wording. It is the sibling of the document_choice card: the card appears when 2..cap candidates match, this appears when the expeditor has to ask which document at all. Six copies across six profiles had drifted into three different wordings, so a change in _handle_fuzzy_file_match would have silently unanswered some and not others. The id is matched exactly, narrowed by the `agents` tag and by arg_name, before the model is asked anything. THE ANSWER IS DELIBERATELY PER-PROFILE and must not be collapsed: these are fixture choices for standalone profiles, not divergence.

entries.question_pattern: Would you like to proceed with these settings?
Are you sure you want to delete
Are you sure you want to update

entries._comment: The DOCUMENT CHOICE CARD, keyed on the card's own id rather than its wording (row a1420538), the same generic entry every other file-arg profile carries. This profile answers the describe ask, so the expeditor can also put the choice card to it: the card appears when 2..cap documents match the request, and a run that reaches it with no entry waits out the ask and expires (row a362fc8b, #8). __first_option__ picks the first listed document; the options are discovered at run time, so no fixed label would hold.
